title: Geometrically convex return risk measures on AM-algebras
abstract: arXiv:2606.26031v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Monetary risk measures quantify the risk of uncertain monetary payoffs (or losses), whereas in time series analysis risk is typically assessed using logarithmic returns. Return risk measures (RRMs) provide an axiomatic foundation for the latter approach, which relies crucially on the positive cone of the space of essentially bounded random variables. We extend RRMs to general ordered vector spaces and characterize positive homogeneity via the geometric epigraph. To investigate geometric convexity and establish connections with monetary risk measures, we specialize the domain as a subset of an AM-algebra, encompassing Euclidean spaces and spaces of multidimensional essentially bounded random variables. The latter is novel in the context of RRMs and leads to the new classes of systemic and vector-valued RRMs. We establish results on finiteness, continuity, separability, as well as dual and aggregation-based representations.

translated_title: AM-代数上的几何凸收益风险度量
translated_abstract: 货币风险度量用于量化不确定货币收益（或损失）的风险，而在时间序列分析中，风险通常是通过 logarithmic 收益（对数收益）来评估的。收益风险度量（RRMs）为后一种方法提供了公理化基础，而该方法的关键在于本性有界随机变量空间的正锥。我们将收益风险度量推广到一般的有序向量空间，并通过几何上图来刻画正齐次性。为了研究几何凸性并建立与货币风险度量之间的联系，我们将定义域特殊化为AM-代数的子集，这一框架涵盖了欧几里得空间以及多维本性有界随机变量空间。后者在收益风险度量的研究背景下是全新的，并由此引出了系统性收益风险度量和向量值收益风险度量这两个新类别。我们建立了关于有限性、连续性、可分性以及基于对偶和聚合的表示的结果。
tldr: 该论文将收益风险度量推广到一般有序向量空间并以AM-代数子集为定义域研究其几何凸性，首次提出了系统性收益风险度量和向量值收益风险度量等新类别，并建立了有限性、连续性、可分性及对偶与聚合表示等结果。
